description: Remove one of your own brand kits for good. The logos and pictures it used stay in your library. Call it first without confirm: it says which kit would be removed and changes nothing. Then, once the person agrees, call again with confirm true. Free.

confirm.description: Leave it out first: the answer says which kit would be removed. Set true only after the person agrees.

kit_id.description: Or the id of one of your kits, from list_brand_kits.

name.description: The name of one of your kits.
